description: Return exposed/converted visitors and statistical comparisons per flag arm. Mixed visitors are excluded. Uses Fisher when any expected cell is below 5, otherwise a two-proportion z-test; minimumVisitorsPerArm gates significance.

controlArm.description: Arm to compare against. Defaults to a variant named control, then false for boolean and rollout flags, then the first variant.

from.description: Inclusive start of the measurement period; pair with to instead of preset.

preset.description: Date preset such as last_7d. Alternative to from/to; defaults to last_30d.

to.description: Inclusive end of the measurement period; pair with from instead of preset.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

name: get_experiment_results

outputSchema.description: flagKey and flagType identify the experiment; goal identifies its conversion goal; startDate/endDate bound the measurement. arms contains each variant's exposed and converted visitor counts, conversionRate percent, isControl, and nullable comparison against controlArm. comparison reports absoluteDifference, relativeLift, confidence bounds ciLow/ciHigh, pValue, testMethod and significant. minimumVisitorsPerArm gates significance; mixedExposureVisitors counts excluded visitors who saw multiple arms. hint explains missing usable exposures.

title: Get experiment results
